verdict.rationale: LocalAI provides `local-ai chat`, a shell agent that reads files and runs commands via natural-language chat behind an approval gate, plus a built-in web chat UI, MCP-based agentic tool use, and function/tool calling — these together let a user drive real actions via natural language. However, this is chat-driven agentic tooling rather than a general natural-language command interface over the whole product (e.g., no evidence of NL-driven CLI/config management beyond chat/agent flows). missing for 10: evidence of natural-language control over broader product operations (model management, deployment, config) beyond the chat/agent and MCP tool-calling features, and independent hands-on confirmation of the approval-gated shell agent working as described.
